partition_method.description: Partitioning method: 'count' (use num_parts), 'files_per_part' (use max_files_per_part), or 'size_per_part' (use max_size_per_part)

num_parts.description: Create exactly this many partitions (option -n); used only when partition_method == 'count'

max_files_per_part.description: Max files per partition (option -f); used only when partition_method == 'files_per_part'

max_size_per_part.description: Max size per partition (option -s); human suffixes allowed (k,m,g,t,p); used only when partition_method == 'size_per_part'

input_file.description: Read file list from this file (option -i); if empty and input_arbitrary is false, uses command-line args

input_arbitrary.description: If true, treat input as arbitrary (option -a); requires input_file to be empty

output_template.description: Output template for partitions (option -o); '-' prints to stdout

add_parent_dirs.description: Add parent directories at end of each partition (option -P)

include_patterns.description: Include patterns (option -y); may be specified multiple times

exclude_patterns.description: Exclude patterns (option -x); may be specified multiple times

pack_all_dirs.description: Pack all directories as empty entries (option -zzz)

pack_erroneous_dirs_separately.description: Pack erroneous directories in dedicated partitions (option -Z); requires live_mode and treat_unreadable_as_empty or pack_all_dirs

depth_limit.description: After this depth, pack directories instead of files (option -d); 0 means disabled

leaf_dirs_only.description: Pack leaf directories only (option -D); implies pack_empty_dirs

dirs_only.description: Pack directories only, no files (option -E); implies leaf_dirs_only

live_mode.description: Enable live mode (option -L); cannot be used with partition_method == 'count'

skip_big_files.description: Skip files bigger than max_size_per_part in live mode (option -S); requires live_mode and max_size_per_part > 0

preload_bytes.description: Preload each partition with this many bytes (option -p); human suffixes allowed (k,m,g,t,p)

overload_bytes.description: Overload each file size with this many bytes (option -q); human suffixes allowed (k,m,g,t,p)

round_bytes.description: Round each file size up to next multiple of this many bytes (option -r); human suffixes allowed (k,m,g,t,p)

pre_part_cmd.description: Execute this command before each partition (option -w)

post_part_cmd.description: Execute this command after each partition (option -W)
